title: AI at work interview information requirements

items.description: Establish the participant's role and core responsibilities.
Obtain a concrete example of the participant's own AI use and what happened, including its outcome or limitations.
items.condition: Applies when the participant has used AI at work. An explicit account of no AI use is a legitimate exception.

items.description: Establish whether and how the participant verifies AI output. An explicit statement that they do not verify it can resolve this requirement.
items.condition: Applies when the participant has used AI at work.

items.description: Explore future AI capabilities the participant would find useful.
